title: Positive-Curvature Discrete Einstein Metrics on Trees
summary: For a weighted tree, the Lin--Lu--Yau Ricci curvature admits an explicit formula in terms of the edge weights. Consequently, the constant-curvature equation is equivalent to an eigenvalue problem for an edge-indexed Ricci matrix $R_T$. Building on the spectral characterization of discrete Einstein metrics on trees, we classify all finite trees whose discrete Einstein metric has positive curvature, equivalently all trees satisfying $λ_{\max}(R_T)<0$.
